gen.orderNote: Follows page order from proposal to certification.

steps.label: Congress proposes joint resolution
steps.quote: The Congress proposes an amendment in the form of a joint resolution.

steps.label: Document forwarded for processing
steps.quote: The original document is forwarded directly to NARA's Office of the Federal Register (OFR) for processing and publication.

steps.label: Archivist submits amendment to states
steps.quote: The Archivist submits the proposed amendment to the States for their consideration by sending a letter of notification to each Governor

steps.label: Governors submit amendment to legislatures
steps.quote: The Governors then formally submit the amendment to their State legislatures or the state calls for a convention

steps.label: State ratifies, sends copy of action
steps.quote: When a State ratifies a proposed amendment, it sends the Archivist an original or certified copy of the State action

steps.label: Certification published as notice
steps.quote: This certification is published in the Federal Register and U.S. Statutes at Large and serves as official notice

checks.message: every sequence text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 6 step quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)
the stated order basis "page-order" holds: quote start offsets strictly ascend in array order (computed by our code; this proves an order signal, not scientific correctness) (order-basis-holds)
every step has a distinct label after normalisation (distinct-steps)
steps count 6 is within 4-8; repair is by retry only (count-valid)
every number in labels, order hints and notes appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
sequence-v1: no weakening — every one of the 1 changed field(s) sits under the affected paths recomputed from revision 1, item counts and ids are stable, and no tolerance increased
